summary: P3 Health Partners filed an 8-K disclosing a September 8, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement with affiliates of CPF for up to $70 million of units sold in tranches under Section 4(a)(2) exemptions. Each unit pairs a Series D-1 19.5% Cumulative Preferred share, stated value $100, with seven-year warrants exercisable at the Nasdaq Minimum Price for 0.66333% of Class A and Class V shares per $1 million funded. The preferred is non-convertible, non-voting, unlisted, senior to common, and redeemable at $100 plus accrued dividends. This is a private financing, not a special situation.
